fields.description: What this deployment serves. Set once — the box, the port and the gateway route are all keyed to it; a different model is a different deployment.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Only provisioned (Active) boxes are offered — a deploy onto anything else fails on the is_provisioned gate.
fields.label: Inference Server

fields.description: Auto-allocated (read-only): lowest free port from 8080 up, scoped to this Inference Server (→ --port / vllm_port). Multi-tenant box → one port per deployment; freed on teardown and reused. Box-local only — the engine proxy is what is reachable from outside.
fields.label: Engine Port

fields.description: The image this deployment serves from — Docker owns its lifecycle (docker ps / docker logs vllm-{slug}). The tag owns the vLLM version and its whole toolchain; the box only supplies the driver. Frozen once deployed — to move to another image, make a new deployment.
fields.label: Engine Image

fields.description: What is inside the image, off the Engine Image. Shown so the form can hide what does not apply; the deploy path reads the Engine Image itself, so this never goes stale against it.
fields.label: Engine Kind

fields.description: Arguments for a custom image's own entrypoint, or blank to run it with none. Each is passed as one argument, so quoting is preserved and nothing reaches the shell. Your image must listen on the Engine Port above.
fields.label: Startup Command

fields.description: Path polled on the Engine Port until it answers 200, before the deploy is called done. Blank uses the engine kind's own — vLLM's /health — and blank for a custom image means no gate at all, so the play finishes as soon as the container starts.
fields.label: Health Path

fields.description: Auto-derived (read-only): https://BOX-IP/e/SLUG — this deployment's location on its box's engine proxy, which forwards to its own vLLM instance. The gateway forwards straight here (no LiteLLM); vLLM serves /v1/messages natively.
fields.label: Engine URL

fields.description: Grove's own key between the gateway and this engine. Generated on the first Deploy and served with — read-only, because a hand-typed value would only ever disagree with the key that is on the box.
fields.label: Internal API Key

fields.description: Owned by the lifecycle buttons and the plays they run — not hand-set.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Provisioning
Active
Inactive
Terminated
Broken

fields.description: Per-box serving knobs — depend on THIS deployment's GPU, not the portable Model profile.
fields.label: Hardware Tuning

fields.description: → --kv-cache-dtype. fp8 halves the KV cache, which buys context on a card short of VRAM, at some accuracy. auto = the weights' own dtype. The weight dtype itself is left to vLLM (it reads the repo's config.json).
fields.label: KV Cache Dtype

fields.description: → --gpu-memory-utilization (0-1). Depends on the GPU's VRAM headroom.
fields.label: GPU Memory Utilization

fields.description: → --max-num-batched-tokens. Tokens one engine step may run at once. Blank = vLLM's own default. Higher fills the GPU on long prompts; lower keeps decode latency down.
fields.label: Max Num Batched Tokens

fields.description: → --max-model-len. Cap for the KV cache; ≤ the model's native context unless the override below is ticked. Blank = 8192. Depends on this box's VRAM headroom.
fields.label: Max Model Len

fields.description: → VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1. vLLM refuses to start when Max Model Len exceeds the context the repo's config.json declares. Tick to override that guard (e.g. RoPE-extended serving). Wrong values give garbage output instead of an error, so only tick when the longer context is intended.
fields.label: Allow Long Max Model Len

fields.description: → --max-num-seqs. Sequences the engine runs concurrently, and the gateway's admission cap: requests in flight on this engine are held to it, and one that would exceed it goes to another replica or is refused with 429. Blank = 1024, passed explicitly rather than left to the image's own default, so the gateway caps at the number the engine is actually running. Also bounds how much KV cache the batch can want, so lower it when a full batch OOMs.
fields.label: Max Num Seqs

fields.description: Which GPUs on this box the engine runs on. Add one row per GPU (CUDA index from the Machine's GPU table). N rows → --tensor-parallel-size N + CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES pinned to those indices. Marked Allocated on Deploy, freed on Tear Down.
fields.label: GPUs

fields.description: Derived = GPU rows / pipeline parallel size. 1 = single-GPU. → --tensor-parallel-size.
fields.label: Tensor Parallel Size

fields.description: Stages to split the model's layers across (--pipeline-parallel-size). 1 = pure tensor parallel. Must divide the number of GPU rows evenly.
fields.label: Pipeline Parallel Size

fields.description: Extra --served-model-name values (comma/space separated); old client model-names keep working.
fields.label: Aliases

fields.description: Freeform extra `vllm serve` flags appended verbatim, e.g. --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-num-seqs 64.
fields.label: Extra Serve Args

fields.description: Everything above, assembled → what the container on the box actually runs. Rebuilt on save; the API key is not in it (it rides VLLM_API_KEY in the env file).
fields.label: Serve Command

fields.description: Extra env vars for the engine process (both placements). Layered on top of the vars Grove derives, so a row here overrides them.
fields.label: Environment Variables

fields.description: How many lines from the end of the log to fetch. Capped at 5000.
fields.label: Lines

fields.description: Runs docker logs against this deployment's container on its box. Nothing is stored on this document.
fields.label: Fetch Engine Logs

fields.description: Follows this deployment's container log live (docker logs --follow over SSH). Streaming stops on its own after 30 minutes.
fields.label: Start Streaming
